physicalNotes: Radius 0.10705701 Jupiter radii from Gómez Maqueo Chew et al. 2026 (2026MNRAS.548ag438G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag438G/abstract): 7,653.7 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Gómez Maqueo Chew et al. 2026 (2026MNRAS.548ag438G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag438G/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.03366596 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
